I am here in Dowa with my small maize plot, and I must plan carefully because cash is tight this year. Last season I got a FISP coupon for one bag of NPK and one bag of urea, and I am hoping for the same again — without it I cannot afford enough fertilizer for even this small plot. I will plant the hybrid seed I bought from the agro-dealer because my neighbor had better cobs last year with it, and I will put the manure from our goats on the plot before the rains. I do all the weeding and planting myself with help from my children, and I cannot spare money to hire people except maybe for a day or two at first weeding if the rains come heavy.
